flexible.strain_convention: core strain: squish depth / the column's latticed height. The tables' nominal strain (over the whole specimen, skins included) is converted once by the loader: strain x height / (height - skin_total), the specimen skins treated as rigid and removed; stress = force / loaded area, unchanged. Skins in the PART are not yet subtracted from the column height (C2 subtracts them), so a skinned face currently reads high by about skin / height.

buildable_smoothing.rule: clamp to the reachable range, then Gaussian sigma = 0.5 x local cell size (R14)

tier.why: a published table for this filament, printed on another machine

not_modelled: first-cycle stiffness: the tables are the 4th cycle; a new part is firmer for its first few squeezes
sideways load spreading: dents have sharper edges than real life, and a small press on a big pad sinks less than shown
